title: Reported Speech
description: Lær å gjengi kva andre har sagt ved hjelp av indirekte tale (reported speech) med korrekte tidsforskyvingar.
competenceGoals: bruke sentrale mønstre for setningsbygning, verbtider og tekstbinding i kommunikasjon

content.content:
## Reported speech -- å gjengi kva andre har sagt

Når du fortel nokon kva ein annan person har sagt, kan du gjere det på to måtar:

**Direct speech** (direkte tale) -- du gjengir orda nøyaktig:
- She said, **"I am tired."**

**Reported speech** (indirekte tale) -- du gjengir innhaldet med dine eigne ord:
- She said **that she was tired.**

Reported speech blir brukt heile tida -- i kvardagen, i nyheitsartiklar, i forteljingar og i akademisk skriving. Utfordringa er at du må endre verbtida og andre element når du går frå direkte til indirekte tale.

content.title: Tense Shift (Tidsforskyving)
content.content:
Når du rapporterer noko som blei sagt i fortida, forskyv du vanlegvis verbtida eitt steg bakover:

| Direct speech | Reported speech |
|---|---|
| Present simple: "I **am** happy." | Past simple: She said she **was** happy. |
| Present continuous: "I **am working**." | Past continuous: He said he **was working**. |
| Past simple: "I **saw** him." | Past perfect: She said she **had seen** him. |
| Present perfect: "I **have finished**." | Past perfect: He said he **had finished**. |
| Will: "I **will** help." | Would: She said she **would** help. |
| Can: "I **can** swim." | Could: He said he **could** swim. |
| May: "I **may** come." | Might: She said she **might** come. |
| Must: "I **must** go." | Had to: He said he **had to** go. |

content.title: Andre endringar i reported speech
content.content:
I tillegg til verbtida blir også pronomen, tidsuttrykk og stadsuttrykk endra:

**Pronomen:**
- I → he/she
- my → his/her
- we → they
- our → their

**Tidsuttrykk:**
- today → that day
- tomorrow → the next day / the following day
- yesterday → the day before / the previous day
- now → then
- this week → that week
- ago → before / earlier

**Stadsuttrykk:**
- here → there
- this → that
- these → those

content.title: Eksempel: Frå direkte til indirekte tale
content.problem:
Gjer desse setningane om til reported speech:

1. Tom said, "I am going to the cinema today."
2. Lisa said, "I finished my homework yesterday."
3. The teacher said, "You must hand in your essays tomorrow."
content.solution:
**1.** Tom said **that he was going to the cinema that day.**
- I → he
- am going → was going (present continuous → past continuous)
- today → that day

**2.** Lisa said **that she had finished her homework the day before.**
- I → she
- finished → had finished (past simple → past perfect)
- yesterday → the day before

**3.** The teacher said **that we had to hand in our essays the next day.**
- You → we (kjem an på kontekst)
- must → had to
- tomorrow → the next day

He explained that he can come to the party.

content.content:
## Reported Questions (Indirekte spørsmål)

Når du rapporterer spørsmål, blir ordstillinga endra frå spørsmålsform til vanleg setningsform:

**Ja/nei-spørsmål:** Bruk *if* eller *whether*:
- Direct: "Do you like pizza?" he asked.
- Reported: He asked **if/whether I liked pizza.**

**Spørjeord-spørsmål:** Behald spørjeordet, men endre ordstillinga:
- Direct: "Where do you live?" she asked.
- Reported: She asked **where I lived.**
- Direct: "What are you doing?" he asked.
- Reported: He asked **what I was doing.**

**Viktig:** I reported questions bruker vi IKKJE spørsmålsform (hjelpeverb + subjekt). Vi bruker vanleg ordstilling (subjekt + verb):
- FEIL: She asked where did I live.
- RETT: She asked where I lived.

exercise.task: Gjer desse spørsmåla om til reported questions.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: "Where are you going?" she asked me.
subTasks.solution: She asked me where I was going.
multipleChoiceOptions: She asked me where I was going.
She asked me where was I going.
She asked me where I am going.
She asked me where do I go.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: "Have you finished your homework?" the teacher asked.
subTasks.solution: The teacher asked if/whether I had finished my homework.
multipleChoiceOptions: The teacher asked if I had finished my homework.
The teacher asked have I finished my homework.
The teacher asked if I have finished my homework.
The teacher asked did I finish my homework.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: "What time does the train leave?" he asked.
subTasks.solution: He asked what time the train left.
multipleChoiceOptions: He asked what time the train left.
He asked what time did the train leave.
He asked what time does the train leave.
He asked what time the train leaves.

exercise.solution: a) where I was going, b) if I had finished, c) what time the train left. Hugs: vanleg ordstilling i reported questions, IKKJE spørsmålsform.

content.content:
## Reported Commands and Requests (Indirekte oppmodingar)

Når du rapporterer oppmodingar, bruk *told/asked + (not) to + infinitiv*:

**Påbod (commands):**
- Direct: "Sit down!" the teacher said.
- Reported: The teacher **told us to sit down.**
- Direct: "Don't run in the corridor!"
- Reported: She **told them not to run** in the corridor.

**Førespurnader (requests):**
- Direct: "Can you help me?" she asked.
- Reported: She **asked me to help her.**
- Direct: "Please don't be late."
- Reported: He **asked us not to be late.**

**Rapporteringsverb:**
- said, told, asked, explained, admitted, promised, warned, suggested, complained, announced

exercise.task: Gjer om til reported speech (blanda oppgåver).

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: "Close the door, please," the teacher said.
subTasks.solution: The teacher asked us to close the door.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: "I will call you tomorrow," she promised.
subTasks.solution: She promised (that) she would call me the next day.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: "Don't touch the painting!" the guard warned.
subTasks.solution: The guard warned us not to touch the painting.

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: "Why didn't you come to the party?" he asked me.
subTasks.solution: He asked me why I hadn't come to the party.

exercise.solution: a) asked us to close, b) promised she would call the next day, c) warned us not to touch, d) asked me why I hadn't come.

exercise.task: Skriveoppgåve: Bruk reported speech i kontekst.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: Intervju ein medelev om helga deira (på engelsk). Still 5 spørsmål. Deretter skriv ein kort rapport (80--100 ord) der du bruker reported speech for å gjengi svara. Eksempel: 'I asked Maria what she did last weekend. She told me that she had visited her grandparents. She said that they had gone for a walk in the mountains.'
subTasks.solution: Eleven gjennomfører intervjuet og skriv ein rapport med korrekt bruk av reported speech, inkludert tidsforskyving og pronomenendringar.

content.content:
## Oppsummering

**Reported speech** blir brukt for å gjengi kva andre har sagt utan å sitere direkte.

**Tidsforskyving:**
- present → past
- past → past perfect
- will → would
- can → could

**Andre endringar:**
- I/my → he/she, his/her
- today → that day
- tomorrow → the next day
- here → there

**Reported questions:**
- Bruk if/whether for ja/nei-spørsmål
- Vanleg ordstilling (ikkje spørsmålsform)

**Reported commands:**
- told/asked + to + infinitiv
- told/asked + not to + infinitiv

**Vanlege feil:**
- Hugs tidsforskyving: "She said she IS tired" er feil → "She said she WAS tired"
- Vanleg ordstilling i spørsmål: "She asked where WAS he" er feil → "She asked where he WAS"
